findings.evidenceJa: 滑稽ね、とイリヤは呟く。
findings.governingReading: Illya murmurs 滑稽ね, comical, aloud.

findings.highlight: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."
findings.evidenceJa: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
findings.governingReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

findings.highlight: Rin takes the question in stride.
findings.evidenceJa: それ故に寒気のする質問に、
findings.governingReading: Question causes chill because Sakura's voice is emotionless; clause leads into Rin's firm response.
findings.explanation: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.

findings.highlight: "Obviously. You're a huge moron, beyond saving from the moment you left this house, because you never put any faith in the one guy who wanted to protect Sakura Matou."
findings.evidenceJa: 「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
findings.governingReading: Failed to trust the man wanting to protect Sakura through to the end, by leaving.
findings.explanation: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.

findings.highlight: "...What's wrong, Nee-san? The way you're backing up almost makes you look like you're scared of me."
findings.evidenceJa: 「……どうしたんですか姉さん。そんなふうに背中をまるめてると、まるで、わたしに怯えているように見えますよ？」
findings.governingReading: Sakura mocks sister hunching/rounding her back as seeming frightened.

findings.highlight: She was never ready to begin with.
findings.governingReading: No question of too late now: everything was already too late when Sakura reached for Illya.
findings.explanation: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.

findings.highlight: A knight weilding a dark, tainted sword emerges.
findings.evidenceJa: 黒く汚染された剣の騎士が這い上がる。
findings.governingReading: Knight of sword emerges dark/tainted; English's intended participle is wielding.

findings.highlight: Rin glares at Sakura, enduring the humiliation.
findings.evidenceJa: 侮辱をかみ殺しながら、凛は桜を睨み返す。
findings.governingReading: Following interrupted you-little insult, Rin glares while suppressing insult she would utter.
findings.explanation: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.

findings.highlight: The "meal" doesn't even last a few seconds.
findings.evidenceJa: 『食事』は、それこそ秒もかからなかった。
findings.governingReading: Meal takes not even one second, 秒もかからなかった.
findings.explanation: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.

findings.highlight: It would be too easy to simply neutralize her by taking her energy.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を奪って無力化したぐらいじゃ甘い。
findings.governingReading: Merely draining and neutralizing her would be 甘い, too soft/lenient in Sakura's self-persuasion to kill.
